tools.name: Nexus SymBiote
tools.note: The development tree: version 0.2.0 plus unreleased changes, not published on PyPI. Shown beside the release for the maintainers; not comparable with other tools' releases.
tools.origin: this repository's source at a13b622 with requirements-ci.lock

tools.name: cdxgen (aibom command)
tools.note: The dedicated `aibom` command with its defaults, which select the `ai` project type.

tools.name: cdxgen (repository command)
tools.note: The command its README gives to generate and audit an AI-BOM from a repository. It detects every project type, so it also reads package manifests and MCP configuration, and by default it runs the project's package manager.

tools.name: agent-bom
tools.note: --offline --no-scan: package vulnerability matching needs a downloaded database and is outside this round; without --no-scan an offline run is reported incomplete.

tools.name: Trusera ai-bom
tools.note: --deep enables its Python AST analysis; LLM enrichment is not used.

tools.name: Syft
tools.note: A general SBOM generator, included as the baseline.

tools.name: xbom
tools.note: Posts usage telemetry on every invocation, including --help; it cannot leave the sandbox.

tools.name: Cisco AI BOM
tools.not_measured: `cisco-aibom analyze` refuses to run without --llm-model, and an LLM provider cannot be reached from a network-isolated run.

tools.name: OWASP AIBOM Generator
tools.not_measured: Its input is a Hugging Face model identifier, which it resolves over the network; it does not scan a repository.

tools.name: k8s-aibom
tools.not_measured: Its input is a running Kubernetes cluster; it does not scan a repository.
